entities.summary: Chao Cuo was a philosopher and thinker of the Classical era, active in Global, known for his contributions to philosophers & thinkers. Born in 199 BCE, he died at 153 BCE. His significance lies in the fact that he was a key figure in the philosophical inquiry of the Classical era, influencing the development of philosophical thought in the region. His ideas were transmitted through various channels, including the transmission of Confucianism and Legalism. He is remembered for his efforts to promote the values of the Chinese state, and his legacy continued to shape the development of Chinese philosophy and politics. Chao Cuo's story serves as a reminder of the importance of understanding the complexities of historical context and the role of individual thinkers in shaping the course of human history.
